evals.prompt: Use the init-project skill. I want to connect my Google Ads account for this project. I have a normal Google Ads account and nothing else. Which variables do I need, and how do I finish the sign-in and verify it? In this session you can only read files and answer in text: say which commands you would run or print, in what order, and what you would check. Answer in at most 200 words, then end with a line starting 'Rules from the skill:' that lists, comma-separated, the commands, flags, config keys, file names and refusals from the skill that you relied on.
evals.expected_output: The Google variables for ads/.env, the google login command and a doctor check; no developer token
expectations: The answer says no developer token is needed
The answer mentions the command `google login`
The answer mentions `doctor --live` as the check

evals.prompt: We only want to run Meta ads with a few generated images, and we have no research budget. Which keys does the stack-ads plugin need for that and which can I skip? Do not run anything.
evals.expected_output: The three Meta variables and one creative key are needed; research, Google and TikTok keys can be skipped
expectations: The answer lists META_ACCESS_TOKEN, META_AD_ACCOUNT_ID and META_PAGE_ID as needed
The answer says one creative key is enough and names at least one of GEMINI_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY or FAL_KEY
The answer says the Firecrawl, Apify and DataForSEO keys can be skipped
The answer says META_AD_ACCOUNT_ID is written as digits without the act_ prefix
